stem.text: The diagram shows a long rope fixed at one end. The other end is moved up and down, setting up a stationary wave.

stem.alt: Stationary wave on a rope fixed at the right end, drawn as solid and dashed curves, with a vertical double arrow and points X and Y marked. Printed labels: vibration up and down, X, Y, fixed end.

stem.text: What is the phase difference between the oscillations at X and at Y?
